_doc: Security lane prompt set — docs/MIMO_V26_DISTILL_9B_BRINGUP_V1.md. Fixed; do not edit between engines or models. sec-clean is the false-positive control.
instruction: Review the following Python code for security vulnerabilities. If there is a vulnerability, name its CWE identifier (format CWE-<number>), give a CVSS v3.1 severity band with a one-line justification, and show a corrected version of the code. If the code has no security vulnerability, say exactly "NO VULNERABILITY FOUND" and explain briefly why it is safe.
